name: Skin editor
author: Brett
description: Skin editor: the skin checker (skin-check@1) for every skin and design package. A live score and grade, the issue list (spacing off the token scale, more than two typefaces or type sizes off the scale, palette sprawl and near-duplicate colours, WCAG contrast, inconsistent radius / border / shadow), a one-click jump to each token with an inline edit that re-runs the check, Fix and Fix all, and the threshold settings. Nav → Plugins → Skin editor; deep link skin-editor/checker?skin=&issue=; REST /api/plugins/skin-editor/checker, MCP skin_editor_*, CLI axf skin, AmberX voice.

keeps: packages/skin-checker: the checker engine, `axf skin` and the CI step are a framework package and stay
